mrt_attachment_descriptors.policy: the captured window (first 0x500 bytes of VA 0x10000018200, covering the arena's own two 0x20-byte header words at absolute +0x000/+0x200 plus the k=0..7 LOAD array at +0x20+k*0x20 and STORE array at +0x220+k*0x20 -- EXP-0048/EXP-M4-08/09/EXP-0108) is masked uniformly at every 0x20-byte-stride boundary: 5 bytes at record-relative +0x08..+0x0c (the low-40-bits-of-a-qword surface-address subfield, EXP-0048/EXP-M4-08's VA=low40<<4 reconstruction) are zeroed before the byte-exact cross-run comparison. Unmasked bytes go only into 03_timing.jsonl's `addresses` field (a small first-0x40-byte excerpt), never cross-run compared.

clear_color_arena.policy: 2 bytes at fixed absolute offset 0x536/0x537 within the captured window (first 0x600 bytes of VA 0x10000128000) were found nondeterministic between two SAME-CASE, SAME-CONFIG dry runs during this experiment's own pre-capture diagnostic phase (PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 2 finding 6 / PROGRESS.md M6) -- masked to zero before comparison. This role's remaining ~1534 bytes in the captured window are NOT independently characterized by this experiment (out of scope, see PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 9); they are carried through the gate only because they were empirically found stable across the diagnostic phase's own repetitions, not because their structure is understood.

analysis_py_post_capture_note: analysis.py (interpretation/reporting only, never data collection) was fixed twice AFTER both run01/run02 captures completed: (1) a little-endian byte-order bug in the H2 mipCount-flag bit26 check (the record hex string was passed straight to int(x,16) instead of being byte-reversed first, so the check silently always read the wrong bit), (2) a KeyError when the one tolerated content_captured flake (m1-mip-level0) left window_hex absent in run_a -- fixed by adding an explicit, disclosed flake-fallback merge (merge_with_flake_fallback) that backfills from whichever run actually captured the content, reported in analysis.json's own flake_fallback_used_for field rather than hidden. Neither fix touched run.py, verify.py, wtrace.c, probe.m, or casematrix.py, and neither required a recapture -- the same pattern EXP-0108's own PROGRESS.md documents for its verify.py/analysis.py iteration after an initial capture attempt. The hash above is analysis.py's POST-fix value (the version that actually produced analysis.json); the original pre-fix hash used at capture time was 94e3e9acf8216c5ed64cc52e3f3447928d9e0e4d49150373daa493aec93c295d, preserved here for the audit trail.

boundary.apple_binary_archive_bo_or_compiled_shad: only our own generated MSL (VS/FS compiled at runtime per case) and its own readback bytes; the interposer never inspects Metal/AGX*/IOGPU framework code

capture.selftest_gate: verify.py --selftest and verify.py --seqtest must pass immediately before every capture, in every tree state; a capture whose verifier gates are unproven is not authorized
capture.smoke_gate: BEFORE any raw/ artifact is created, the freshly built harness must run ONE scratch case (CM.CASES[0]) into work/ (never promoted into raw/) whose result parses to status OK; any build or smoke defect exits 3 with the receipt printed and NO burned run id
capture.between_runs_gate: run01 must be a complete closed successful raw tree (04_dispatch.json present, n_cases == 16) and raw/run02 absent before run02 is created
capture.cross_run_byte_exact_scope: for every case, every CASE_KEYS field must be identical between run01 and run02 AFTER the address_normalization masking above is applied by run.py itself (i.e. the comparison in verify.py --captured operates on the already-masked gated record, with no further projection needed) -- EXCEPT a role's `content_captured` flag is tolerated to differ (size/presence must still agree) up to a budget of 3 such flakes across the 16-case matrix, empirically justified by the widened mach_vm_read_overwrite retry budget (PROGRESS.md M5) which is expected to (but is not proven to) eliminate this class of flake entirely.
capture.cross_run_provenance_gate: run02 authored-file hashes must equal the closed run01 input record; git revision need only resolve to a real commit object (pinned_git_revision above is the frozen comparison point per SUBAGENT_BRIEF.md, not live HEAD).
